buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) 1. EMD Exemption: Bidders seeking exemption from Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) shall upload a valid MSME/Udyam Registrat ion Certificate, duly certified by a Chartered Accountant (CA) bearing a valid Unique Document Identificati on Number (UDIN), wherever applicable. The bidder shall also submit a declaration issued by the Chartere d Accountant on the CA's official letterhead, duly signed and bearing the CA's seal and UDIN. The bidder s

hall further submit an EMD Exemption Affidavit executed on non-judicial stamp paper of ₹100/-, specificall y mentioning the relevant bid number and details. The exemption shall be subject to the applicable Gover nment of India/GeM rules and the eligibility criteria prescribed in the bid. 2. Self-Attestation of Documents: All documents submitted with the bid shall be duly self-attested by the bidder or its authorised signatory, b earing the signature, date of signing, and the official seal/stamp of the organisation, wherever applicable. 3. Declaration Regarding Blacklisting/Debarment: All partners, directors, and members of the bidding entity, as applicable, shall submit an affidavit declaring that they have not been associated with, or involved in, any firm or organisation that has been blacklisted or debarred by any Government Department, Government Organisation, or Public Sector Undertaking. Any material concealment or misrepresentation in this regard may result in rejection of the bid and/or other ac tion as permissible under the applicable rules. 4. Restriction on Participation Through Multiple Organisations: Any authorised signatory, partner, director, or member associated with a bidding organisation shall not par ticipate in the same bid through more than one firm or organisation, whether in an individual capacity or in any representative capacity. If it is established that the same person has participated in the bid through m ultiple firms or organisations, all such bids may be rejected and the concerned firms may be disqualified at the technical evaluation stage, subject to the applicable procurement rules and the terms of the bid. 5. Execution and Notarisation of Affidavits/Declarations: All affidavits and declarations required under these ATC shall be executed on 100/-Rs non-judicial stamp p aper and duly notarised. Unless otherwise specified in the bid, the First Party shall be the bidder, and the S econd Party shall be the Principal, PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Gomti Nagar, Lucknow. Each affidavit or de claration shall clearly mention the relevant bid number and title on the stamp paper's first page. The stam p paper shall be purchased on or after the date of publication of the bid and on or before the bid submissio n end date, wherever such a requirement is legally applicable. 6. Proof of Constitution of the Firm/Authorisation: The bidder shall upload the applicable supporting document establishing the legal constitution of the biddi ng entity, such as a Sole Proprietorship Declaration, Partnership Deed, Certificate of Incorporation, or other relevant registration document, as applicable. Where the bid is signed or submitted by an authorised repre sentative, a valid Power of Attorney or other legally acceptable authorisation document shall also be uploa ded along with the bid. 7. Consequences of Non-Compliance: Failure to submit the documents, affidavits, declarations, or certificates required under these ATC, or sub mission of incomplete, invalid, or materially misleading documents, may result in rejection of the bid at the technical evaluation stage, subject to the applicable GeM terms and conditions and Government procurem ent rules. .
